namespace Contribution

open B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution
open B_4f4126122d0700524796c405e145badf09c1ce0f46ce2280744811f1b2bad118.Contribution

variable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}

theorem plaq_triv {p a r b : G} (hp : p = 1) (hr : r = 1) (h : p * a * r⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = 1) :
    a = b := by
  rw [hp, hr, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] at h
  exact mul_inv_eq_one.mp h

theorem plaq_comm {p a r b : G} (h : p * a * r⁻¹ * b⁻¹ = 1) : p * a = b * r := by
  rw [mul_inv_eq_one, mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul] at h
  exact h

theorem shift_coord' (x : Site d L) {τ μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) :
    (x + e μ : Site d L) τ = x τ := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, e_ne (Ne.symm h), add_zero]

theorem sliceBase_shift (x : Site d L) {τ μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) :
    sliceBase (x + e μ) τ = sliceBase x τ + e μ := by
  funext ν
  by_cases hν : ν = τ
  · rw [hν, Pi.add_apply, sliceBase, sliceBase, Function.update_self, Function.update_self,
      e_ne (Ne.symm h), add_zero]
  · rw [Pi.add_apply, sliceBase, sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne hν, Function.update_of_ne hν,
      Pi.add_apply]

theorem last_wrap [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :
    x + e τ = sliceBase x τ := by
  funext ν
  by_cases hν : ν = τ
  · rw [hν, sliceBase, Function.update_self]
    exact (ZMod.val_eq_zero _).mp (val_add_e_of_last x τ hx)
  · rw [Pi.add_apply, e_ne hν, add_zero, sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne hν]

theorem line_val [NeZero L] (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hb : b τ = 0) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < L) :
    ((b + k • e τ : Site d L) τ).val = k := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self, hb, zero_add, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk]

theorem sliceBase_coord (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : sliceBase x τ τ = 0 :=
  Function.update_self _ _ _

/-- Along a `τ`-line, links that are invariant under one `τ`-step are constant. -/
theorem static_line [NeZero L] (V : LinkConfig G d L) (τ μ : Fin d) (b : Site d L)
    (hb : b τ = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ y : Site d L, (y τ).val + 1 < L → V (y + e τ) μ = V y μ) :
    ∀ k, k < L → V (b + k • e τ) μ = V b μ
  | 0, _ => by rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
  | k + 1, hk => by
    rw [← shift_succ' b τ k, hstep _ (by rw [line_val b τ hb (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk)]; exact hk),
      static_line V τ μ b hb hstep k (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk)]
where
  shift_succ' (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) : b + k • e τ + e τ = b + (k + 1) • e τ :=
    (add_assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (b + ·) (succ_nsmul _ k).symm)

/-- Classical vacua of lattice Yang–Mills reduce to static data. For a faithful unitary
representation `ρ` (pr-10), a configuration with vanishing Wilson action is gauge equivalent
(via the axial gauge of pr-12) to a flat configuration `V` whose `τ`-links are trivial off the
last slice, whose other links are independent of the `τ`-coordinate, and whose last-slice
links — the Polyakov loops `P` — obey the parallel-transport relation
`P(b) V(b, μ) = V(x, μ) P(b + e_μ)` with `b` the base point of `x`. -/
theorem result :
    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (n d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (τ : Fin d)
      (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ), IsUnitaryRep ρ → Function.Injective ρ →
      ∀ U : LinkConfig G d L, wilsonAction ρ U = 0 →
        ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
          IsFlat (gaugeAct g U) ∧
          (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 < L → gaugeAct g U x τ = 1) ∧
          (∀ (x : Site d L) (μ : Fin d), μ ≠ τ →
            gaugeAct g U x μ = gaugeAct g U (sliceBase x τ) μ) ∧
          (∀ (x : Site d L) (μ : Fin d), μ ≠ τ → (x τ).val + 1 = L →
            polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ * gaugeAct g U (sliceBase x τ) μ =
              gaugeAct g U x μ * polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ + e μ) τ) := by
  intro G _ n d L _ τ ρ hρ hinj U hS
  have hflat : IsFlat U :=
    ((B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution.result).2.1
      G n d L ρ hρ U).2.2.2 hinj |>.mp hS
  obtain ⟨g, h1, h2, -⟩ :=
    B_4f4126122d0700524796c405e145badf09c1ce0f46ce2280744811f1b2bad118.Contribution.result
      G d L τ U
  have hV : IsFlat (gaugeAct g U) := fun x μ ν => by
    rw [plaquette_gaugeAct, hflat x μ ν, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hstep : ∀ μ : Fin d, μ ≠ τ → ∀ y : Site d L, (y τ).val + 1 < L →
      gaugeAct g U (y + e τ) μ = gaugeAct g U y μ := fun μ hμ y hy =>
    plaq_triv (h1 y hy) (h1 _ (by rw [shift_coord' y hμ]; exact hy)) (hV y τ μ)
  refine ⟨g, hV, h1, fun x μ hμ => ?_, fun x μ hμ hx => ?_⟩
  · have hk := static_line (gaugeAct g U) τ μ (sliceBase x τ) (sliceBase_coord x τ)
      (hstep μ hμ) (x τ).val (ZMod.val_lt _)
    rwa [sliceBase_add_val] at hk
  · have hc := plaq_comm (hV x τ μ)
    rw [h2 x hx, last_wrap x τ hx,
      h2 _ (by rw [shift_coord' x hμ]; exact hx), sliceBase_shift x hμ] at hc
    exact hc

end Contribution
